name: Enacting party identifier
description: To identify the party enacting an instruction.

values.name: Applicant's bank
values.description: Applicant's bank The financial institution which is requested to issue the documentary credit.

values.name: Issuing bank
values.description: Issuing bank The financial institution which issues the documentary credit, if the applicant's bank is not acting as the issuing bank.

values.name: Beneficiary's bank
values.description: Beneficiary's bank The financial institution with which the beneficiary maintains an account.

values.name: Buyer
values.description: Buyer The buyer is responsible for carrying out the instruction.

values.name: Seller
values.description: Seller The seller is responsible for carrying out the instruction.

values.name: Advise-through bank
values.description: Advise-through bank Identifies the financial institution through which the advising bank is to advise the documentary credit.

values.name: Advising bank
values.description: Advising bank Identifies the financial institution used by the issuing bank to advise the documentary credit.

values.name: Debtor's bank
values.description: Debtor's bank Identifies the bank from whom payment is due.

values.name: Ordered bank
values.description: Ordered bank The financial institution with which the ordering party maintains an account.
